name: ChiSale
fix_description: In buy, the referral reward ETH is calculated based on msg.value (total ETH sent) instead of the actual ETH spent (msg.value - remainder). When a buyer sends more ETH than needed, the excess is refunded but the reward is still calculated on the full amount. Fix: calculate reward based on (msg.value - remainder) which is the actual purchase amount.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is extremely short and effectively demonstrates a single-step issue: calling Balancer Vault.flashLoan with an arbitrary recipient that already implements receiveFlashLoan. It requires minimal protocol-specific reasoning, no swap/price manipulation logic, and only one meaningful external interaction.
